description_en: Modifies the attributes of a specified enterprise code
description_zh: 调用UpdateEnterpriseCode更改指定企业码的属性
kebab_example: aliyun smartag update-enterprise-code --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --enterprise-code 12P00 --is-default true --client-token 02fb3da40000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateEnterpriseCode

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the region to which the enterprise code belongs.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~69813~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
